title: Peer descriptor
description: Private binding of a provider's capabilities, disclosed only to connected agents for capabilities in scope.

descriptor_version.description: Descriptor version; must match the assertion's dsc_ver.

endpoint.description: The provider's MCP endpoint for capability calls.

token_endpoint.description: Where to exchange a relationship assertion for an access token.

items.description: Binding: capability_id, version, tool_name, input_schema, output_schema, authorization and execution_admission settings. With measured, tested and quality_tier as in search results.

quality_tier.description: The service's quality tier when one applies; absent otherwise and while tiers are not published.

capabilities.description: One binding per capability in scope.
